public_packet.brief: You triage the overnight alert queue. Go through every open alert, look up the service it belongs to, and give each alert exactly one outcome by the triage rules: merge it into another alert, close it, escalate it (page the on-call), or route it to the owning team. public_packet.policy: Apply these rules in order; the first one that matches decides the alert. (1) MERGE: only alerts whose source is "monitor" can be duplicates or roots; synthetic alerts are never merged (rule 2 closes them). A monitor alert is a duplicate if another monitor alert with the same service_id and the same signature was opened earlier: merge it into the earliest one (the root; give its id as `into`).
